refnamediv.refpurpose: This function generates a triangular pulse over the interval [-w/2, w/2] sampled at times t.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: y = tripuls(t) y = tripuls(t, w) y = tripuls(t, w, skew)

listitem.para: Real number. The default value is 1.
Real number in the interval [-1, 1], The default value is 0.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function generates a triangular pulse which is sampled at times t over the interval [-w/2,w/2]. The value of skew lies between -1 and 1. The value of skew represents the relative placement of the peak in the given width.
